metadata.description: App Store Connect through Heimdall: one plug-in per area, plus the skill.

plugins.name: heimdall
plugins.description: The Heimdall skill: what the asc-* plug-ins can do, which one owns what, and how to stay inside the credential boundary. Install it with whichever areas you pick.

plugins.name: asc-access
plugins.description: Your App Store Connect team: members and roles, invitations, sandbox test accounts.

plugins.name: asc-analytics
plugins.description: Sales and finance reports, analytics report requests, performance and diagnostic data — for questions about downloads, revenue and crashes.

plugins.name: asc-app-clips
plugins.description: App Clips: default and advanced experiences, header images, review details, beta invocations.

plugins.name: asc-background-assets
plugins.description: Background Assets (iOS 26): asset packs downloaded outside the app binary, and their releases.

plugins.name: asc-distribution
plugins.description: Shipping a version: App Store versions and localizations, builds, review details, submission and release, export compliance, EU alternative distribution.

plugins.name: asc-game-center
plugins.description: Game Center: achievements, leaderboards, activities, challenges, groups, matchmaking.

plugins.name: asc-general
plugins.description: The app's identity and store facts: names and subtitles, categories, availability by country, age rating, EULA, accessibility labels, tags.

plugins.name: asc-marketing
plugins.description: Store presence beyond the version page: custom product pages, product page optimization, in-app events, customer reviews, nominations.

plugins.name: asc-monetization
plugins.description: Money: subscriptions, in-app purchases, offers and codes, app pricing, StoreKit 2 transactions.

plugins.name: asc-provisioning
plugins.description: Code signing: bundle IDs and capabilities, certificates, devices, provisioning profiles, merchant and pass type IDs.

plugins.name: asc-testflight
plugins.description: TestFlight: builds for testing, beta groups and testers, external review, crash and screenshot feedback.

plugins.name: asc-webhooks
plugins.description: Webhooks pushing App Store Connect events to your endpoint, their deliveries and pings.

plugins.name: asc-xcode-cloud
plugins.description: Apple's CI/CD: workflows, build runs, artifacts, test results, source control.
